source.contributors: Moto contributors; original issue author jtherrmann

grader.execution: Original constants execute unchanged. Exact AST function bodies execute without unused container imports.
grader.missingAndErrors: Original grader semantics are unchanged. Selected missing or nonpassing statuses are failures, not setup successes.
grader.counts: Observed selected original statuses only; counts are not assertion or subcase counts.
grader.timeoutPolicy: original/grading.py:54-70 and 230-248 reject TESTS_TIMEOUT before parsing and leave resolved false. Owned pytest timedOut maps to the same unresolved outcome, even with partial PASSED stdout. Raw command output and exit are retained.
grader.runnerOwnership: Python -I loads pinned pytest and installed pytest11 plugins before adding current workspace source. Root pytest.py cannot replace the runner.

runtime.dependencies: 26 exact original application lock entries, with hashes in requirements-hashed.txt
runtime.bootstrap: stdlib venv and runtime-embedded ensurepip pip 25.0.1, separate from the application lock
runtime.sourceImports: Only the owned 300-second pytest lifecycle adds the current workspace to sys.path, after trusted runner imports. Candidate import identities are collected from already loaded modules when pytest returns. Trusted helper, venv and pip operations use Python -I; snapshots import no candidate code. No Moto wheel, editable loader, uv, private cache, system install or container is required.
